settings/tournament.name: The 5-Variant Chess Gauntlet (6 Clubs)
settings/tournament.conditions:
### The 5-Variant Chess Gauntlet
Welcome to the Inter-Club Chess Championship! Instead of standard slow chess, 6 clubs (T1–T6) compete simultaneously across 5 fast-paced rounds, facing every other club once—and playing a different chess variant in every single round.

#### Tournament Format & Scoring
- **Structure:** 5-Round Rotating League (3 matches played simultaneously per round).
- **Time Control:** 10 minutes per player (10 min) across all rounds.
- **Rest Breaks:** 3–4 minutes between Rounds 1–4, and a 5-minute break before the Round 5 finale.
- **Points System:**
  - 👑 **Win:** 2 Points
  - 🤝 **Draw:** 1 Point
  - ❌ **Loss:** 0 Points
- **Tie-Breakers:** If clubs finish tied on points after Round 5, rankings are decided by **Head-to-Head result**, followed by **Total Wins**.

#### The 5 Variants (Round by Round)
- **Round 1 — Classic (10 min):** Standard chess rules at 10 minutes per player. Checkmate or run your opponent out of time to win.
- **Round 2 — Duck Chess:** Played with a physical "Duck" token on the board. On every turn, make a normal move and then place the Duck on any empty square. Neither player can move through or land on the Duck. **Win Condition:** Capture the opponent's King (or stalemate = WIN for trapped player).
- **Round 3 — Giveaway Chess (Anti-Chess):** Everything is reversed: your goal is to lose all of your pieces (or get stalemated). **Win Condition:** Capturing is mandatory. Kings have no special value.
- **Round 4 — 3-Check Chess:** Played with 3 check tokens per player. **Win Condition:** First to put opponent's King in check 3 times (regular checkmate also wins). Must announce "Check" out loud; false check call results in +1 minute penalty.
- **Round 5 — Physical Relay Chess (The Finale):** Standard chess rules with a physical twist: whenever you put your opponent in Check, the checked player cannot touch any chess piece until they sprint to their designated bell some meters away, ring it audibly so the referee hears it, and return to the board. **Win Condition:** Deliver checkmate or win on the clock while balancing board strategy with sprint speed. (Checkmate ends the game immediately—no sprint required. Touching any piece before ringing the bell counts as an illegal move and awards +1 minute to the opponent).

#### Matchup Schedule
- **Round 1 (Classic 10 min):** Match 1: T1 vs T6 | Match 2: T2 vs T5 | Match 3: T3 vs T4
- **Round 2 (Duck Chess):** Match 1: T5 vs T3 | Match 2: T1 vs T2 | Match 3: T6 vs T4
- **Round 3 (Giveaway Chess):** Match 1: T4 vs T2 | Match 2: T5 vs T6 | Match 3: T3 vs T1
- **Round 4 (3-Check Chess):** Match 1: T2 vs T6 | Match 2: T1 vs T4 | Match 3: T3 vs T5
- **Round 5 (Physical Relay Chess):** Match 1: T1 vs T5 | Match 2: T6 vs T3 | Match 3: T4 vs T2
